I\'m %1$s. What can I help with?
That document is too large. Bruce reads files up to 20 MB.
That PDF is password-protected, so Bruce cannot read it.
Bruce can read PDFs and plain text files only.
That document has no text Bruce can read. A scanned PDF holds only images.
That document could not be read.
That image could not be read.
This voice sends the text to its provider over the internet. Install an offline voice in Android\'s text-to-speech settings to keep it on the phone.

resources.string: This conversation is too long for the model. Start a new chat.
The model could not finish that reply.
Stopped: the model kept asking for skills without answering.
The model finished without an answer. Try asking again, or in other words.
Could not reach the model\'s server. Check it is running and that this phone can reach it.
Nearly full. New messages will push the oldest out; the chat carries on.
The model no longer sees the messages above. They stay here and in the saved chat.
Summary: the model now sees this instead of the messages above

The context is how much of this chat the model can read at once. When it is full, the chat does not end: each new message pushes the oldest ones out of what the model sees. They stay on screen and in the saved chat.
No longer waiting. Ask again if you still want this.
Fast, energetic and a little silly. Keeps things moving.
Curious, calm and thoughtful. Observes first, speaks when it helps.
What Bruce may do, and when it asks first
Declined: never used. Ask: Bruce asks you before each use. Accepted: used without asking.
Locked off until you grant a file or folder in Permissions.
Locked off until Search my files is set up in Settings and has indexed something.
Locked off until you save a web search key in Settings.
Locked off while Network is set to Offline.
This skill can make changes that cannot be undone. When it is Accepted, Bruce uses it without asking you first. Ask is safer.
Reads the phone\'s date, time and time zone.
Reads the battery level, charging state and temperature.
Reads the phone\'s maker, model, Android version, processor and memory. No serial numbers or other identifiers.
Reads total, used and free storage space.
Reads whether the phone is online and whether it uses Wi-Fi or mobile data. No addresses.
Lists what is inside files and folders you have granted.
Reads plain-text files you have granted, or files inside folders you have granted.
Creates new plain-text files in folders you have granted.
Replaces the whole text of a plain-text file you have granted.
Lists your calendar events for the days asked about.
Adds events to your calendar. You approve each one.
Changes an event\'s title, time, place or notes. You approve each change. Repeating events are left alone.
Deletes an event from your calendar. You approve each one. Repeating events are left alone.
Android did not allow it, so the skill stays off.
Opens the share sheet with text Bruce wrote; you pick where it goes.
Opens a page in your browser, where the network mode allows the site.
Opens an app on the phone by its name.
Opens your messaging app with a message written. You send it; Bruce never sends messages.
Opens your phone app with a number ready. You place the call; Bruce never calls.
Finds the passages of your granted files that answer a question, from the index on the phone.
Sets a reminder that appears as a notification at the time you give. See and cancel them in Settings, Reminders.
Answers a request later, once or every day or week; you approve each one. With the phone\'s own model it waits until the phone is charging. Skills that ask first are not used in a task.
A scheduled task did not run
No model could be loaded for it.
Start a new chat, or speak to Bruce.
Make Bruce the app the assistant gesture opens: pick it under Digital assistant app in Android\'s default apps. No wake word; Bruce never listens in the background.
Bruce opens a new chat from the assistant gesture. Change it in Android\'s default apps.

Lets Bruce search the text of the files and folders you have granted, on this phone. It needs a 334 MB search model (EmbeddingGemma, by Google), used only while indexing or searching, and takes a few minutes to read your files.
%1$d files, %2$d passages indexed. Updated daily while charging, and when your grants change.
Reading your files… %1$d looked at so far.
Deletes the search model and the index of your files from this phone. Your files are not touched.
Save this model as a profile
This chat\'s profile uses a model that is no longer here. Choose another from the title.
What Bruce will remind you of, and scheduled tasks
No reminders or scheduled tasks. Ask Bruce to remind you of something, or to do something later, with those skills turned on.
Android may deliver these a few minutes late, as exact alarms are not allowed for Bruce.
Android may deliver Bruce\'s reminders a few minutes late. Allow exact alarms in Android\'s settings to have them on time.
Opens the camera for you to take a photo; you send it with your next message.
Finds a contact by name and gives only the phone number or email address asked for.
Used only by the contacts skill, to find a person by name when asked.
Finds where the phone is, once, when a question needs it. Approximate unless you allow precise location. Never tracks you.
Used only by the location skill, once each time it is asked where the phone is.
Only if you chose it when Android asked; otherwise the location skill uses approximate location.
Posts a notification with a note you asked for. Bruce never reads other apps\' notifications.
Puts text Bruce wrote on the clipboard for you to paste. Bruce never reads the clipboard.
Renames single files inside folders you have granted, in the same folder.
Moves single files between folders you have granted.
Deletes single files inside folders you have granted. Deleted files cannot be recovered.
Looks up which phone settings Bruce knows about, such as brightness or Wi-Fi. Reads nothing from the phone.
Reads the current value of a phone setting, such as screen timeout or whether Bluetooth is on.
Changes brightness, adaptive brightness, screen timeout, auto-rotate, vibrate on touch and volumes. Needs Modify system settings in Permissions for all but volumes.
Searches the web with the service chosen in Settings (LangSearch or Brave), using your own key, and gives Bruce text from the best pages.
Searches Wikipedia, with no key or sign-up, and gives Bruce the matching articles\' titles, addresses and excerpts.
Reads a web page\'s text, only from sites your network setting allows. In Approved sites mode it asks before reaching a new site.
Opens the phone\'s settings page for a setting Bruce cannot change, such as Wi-Fi, so you can change it.
Shows at the top of the chat how much of the model\'s context the chat uses, green to red as it fills.
When on, Bruce saves lasting facts from your chats on this phone and uses relevant ones in later chats. Per model: each model has its own memory.
Facts Bruce saved from your chats. They stay on this phone. Switching memory off or between modes keeps them; delete them here.
When a chat nears the model\'s limit, the oldest messages are replaced, in what the model sees, by a short summary shown in the chat. Off: the oldest messages are left out instead.
Auto uses the CPU. GPU backends are experimental: on some phones they give wrong answers or freeze the phone.
A reply that is not finished after this long is stopped. The text already written stays. A reply being shown on screen is let finish.
Models that can reason first do so. Replies take longer; the reasoning shows folded above the answer. Some models always think, whatever this says.
Auto picks the biggest size that keeps Bruce within 30% of the phone\'s memory and the model within 6 GB (16K at most for models bigger than that), up to what the model was trained for.

Auto picks the biggest size that keeps Bruce within 30%% of the phone\'s memory and the model within 6 GB (16K at most for models bigger than that), up to what the model was trained for: %1$s for the loaded model.
With the loaded model, instructions and skills take about %1$,d tokens, leaving about %2$,d for the chat. Choose a longer context.
Applied the next time a model is loaded.
What Bruce may access on this phone
Delete models, chats and settings from this phone
This deletes every downloaded or imported model and every saved chat, and resets all settings. It cannot be undone.
No files or folders granted yet.
Android no longer gives Bruce access to this. Revoke it and add it again.
Android did not let Bruce keep access to that. Try another location.
Has instructions for AI helpers. Review them before Bruce uses them.
This folder\'s instructions cannot be used.

This folder has instructions for AI helpers. If you follow them, Bruce reads them when it works with files here. They cannot give Bruce more access or skip a confirmation. If they change, Bruce asks again.
Always granted by Android. It cannot be turned off.
Lets Bruce tell you when a long reply finishes while you are using another app.
Lets the Change settings skill change brightness, screen timeout, auto-rotate and vibrate on touch. Nothing else uses it.
Used only by the calendar skills, when you turn one on and it lists or changes events.
Used only by the calendar skills to add, change or delete an event you approved.
Used only while you speak a message after tapping the microphone. Speech is turned into text on the phone; the audio is not kept or sent anywhere.
Used only as far as the Network mode setting allows. In Offline mode Bruce reaches nothing.
Android grants this by itself to apps that use the internet and were built for Android 16 or earlier. Bruce needs it only to reach a model server on your local network; otherwise you can turn it off.
Lets the network status skill say whether the phone is online and how. It reads no addresses.
The kennel is empty. Import a GGUF file to get started.
The file is removed from this phone. You can import or download it again later.
Limited Skill Use: This model\'s chat template has no tool support and will not use skills
Looking for another copy with a tool template…
No other copy of this model with a tool template was found.
Nothing leaves this phone. Model search and downloads are off.
Bruce may reach Hugging Face to search, sign in and download models. Nothing else.
Wikipedia search needs no key. For the whole web, choose a service and save your own key for it:
LangSearch is free: sign up for a free key, no payment card. It keeps the searches it receives to improve its service. Your key stays encrypted on this phone.
Brave Search is paid: $5 per 1,000 searches, with $5 of free use each month, and a payment card is needed to sign up. Your key stays encrypted on this phone.
A key is saved for this service.
That does not look like a key: 8 to 256 characters, no spaces.
None yet. The first time a skill reaches a new site, Bruce asks, and you can always allow it.
Hugging Face, plus web sites you approve for skills that use the web.
Hugging Face, and any web site that skills reach.
Needed for gated models such as Llama and Gemma, and your private models.
Allow Hugging Face in Network to sign in.
Create a Read token at huggingface.co/settings/tokens and paste it here. It is kept encrypted on this phone. Write tokens are refused: Bruce only downloads.
Allow Hugging Face in Network to sign in.
Could not reach Hugging Face. Check the connection and try again.
The sign-in page came back unexpectedly. Try again.
Hugging Face did not allow the sign-in.
Hugging Face did not complete the sign-in. Try again.
Hugging Face did not accept that token. Copy it again from huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
That token can change your repositories. Bruce only downloads: create a Read token instead.
Couldn\'t sniff out a match. Try other filters.
Bruce can\'t run %1$s as it is published. These are copies of it in a format Bruce can run.
Bruce can\'t run %1$s as it is published, and Hugging Face lists no copy in a format Bruce can run.
Sniffing out models for this phone…
Tested by Bruce: recommended for this phone
These fits are judged from file size alone. Download checks the file itself first and stops if it cannot fit.
Allow Hugging Face in Settings → Network to search and download.
Could not reach Hugging Face. Check the connection.
Hugging Face is limiting requests. Try again shortly.
This model is gated or private: sign in, and accept its terms on huggingface.co.
The model is installed, but its image support stopped: %1$s. Retry adds only the image support.
Downloads with image support (%1$s, %2$s), counted in the memory shown.
Not downloaded: this model needs about %1$s of memory, and about %2$s is free on this phone.
Bruce is a sidekick that runs entirely on this phone. A few choices first. You can change all of them later in Settings.
Bruce works without the internet. Allow Hugging Face if you want to find and download models from inside Bruce.
Bruce can tell you when a long reply finishes while you are using another app.
Bruce needs a model file (GGUF) to chat. Import one you already have, or download one from Hugging Face.
To download, go back and allow Hugging Face.
How much of a chat the model can see at once. Bigger sizes let it remember more of the chat but use more of the phone\'s memory. Only sizes this phone can run are shown.
Auto picks the biggest size that keeps Bruce within 30% of this phone\'s memory, so the model stays in memory. You can change this later in Settings.

Skills let Bruce do things on this phone, such as checking the battery or reading your calendar. Phone-status skills run when needed; every other skill asks you each time. Each skill\'s description takes room in the model\'s context, leaving less for the chat. You can change any skill later in Settings, Skills.
With these skills on, Bruce\'s instructions take about %1$d tokens, more than a quarter of the %2$d-token context. Turn some kinds off, or choose a bigger context size.
Good all-rounder. Uses skills such as the time, battery and sums reliably, and answers everyday questions well.
Uses skills well and answers everyday questions, but slowly on this phone: a few words a second.
Quick to reply and dependable with skills. Solid everyday answers.
Strong answers, and honest about what it cannot check. A larger download, slower to start.
Nothing dug up yet. Chats are saved here as you go.
No archived chats. Nothing buried here.
Markdown is easy to read. JSON keeps everything, including skill results. You choose where the file is saved; nothing is sent anywhere.
Could not save the export there.
Saves every chat, archived ones too, to a file you choose.
Removes every saved and archived chat from this phone.
Images from the web load only in the Any site network mode.
The image could not be loaded.
Run models on your own llama.cpp server, or any server with an OpenAI-compatible API, instead of on this phone. Your chats are sent to the server you add; skills still run on the phone.
Not encrypted: others on this network could read your chats.
Connected, but the server lists no models.
